items.title: 甫修補的N-central資安漏洞疑似遭到利用
items.summary: 上週末N-able在一天之內發布兩次N-central更新，修補CVE-2026-86206、CVE-2026-86207，以及CVE-2026-86218（CVSS v4.0嚴重程度評分為6.9、7.7、10分），威脅情報公司Huntress提出警告，這些漏洞疑似都已遭到利用，IT人員應儘速套用最新的2026.3 Hotfix 4（2026.3.1.14）因應。

items.title: OpenVPN修補8個漏洞，包含可能導致服務阻斷、執行惡意程式碼的高風險漏洞
items.summary: 開源VPN軟體OpenVPN近日發布資安公告，修補8個資安漏洞，包含3個高風險漏洞，涵蓋軟體核心可靠性層及Windows相關元件，影響2.6.22、2.7.6與更早版本，用戶應升級至已修補完成的2.7.7版。

items.title: Keycloak存在重大密碼重設漏洞，恐導致攻擊者接管帳號
items.summary: 開源身分與存取管理伺服器專案Keycloak近日發布資安公告，揭露涉及身分驗證程序的重大漏洞CVE-2026-18963，除了影響Keycloak自身的上游版本外，同時也影響Red Hat Build of Keycloak（RHBK），Keycloak用戶應升級至已修補完成的26.7.2版，RHBK用戶則應視使用的分支版本升級至26.4.15或26.6.6版

items.title: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制
items.summary: 隨著生成式AI導入企業的速度加快，機敏資料外洩的防護與影子AI的治理已成為企業與資安業者共同的課題。除了國際科技與資安大廠積極布局AI Security，這幾年來，臺灣陸續有業者投入相關產品發展，中華資安國際也是其中之一，今年上半年正式進軍這塊市場，7月正式推出名為「AI安檢通道（AI Archway）」的產品。

items.title: feat(cloud): choose an operating system for cloud sessions next to ma…
items.summary: feat(cloud): choose an operating system for cloud sessions next to machine class (#142095) * feat(cloud): choose an operating system for cloud sessions next to machine class Cloud placements could choose a machine class but could not retain an operating-system choice. Carry provider-advertised OS options through the picker, moves, profile settings, RPC, and provisioning. Crabbox advertises Linux only until other targets prove enrollment. Persist move overrides in a lazily ensured nullable target_os column alongside target_machine_class, without changing the schema version. * fix(cloud): preserve the project preparation callback contract Keep machineClass in the second positional argument used by shipped worker-provider plugins, and pass the operating system as an optional third argument. Cover legacy callback behavior through project provisioning and restart replay. * fix(crabbox): satisfy catalog and warm-image lint checks Preserve operating-system catalog output without map spreads. Move warm-image timeout policy and fork response validation into the existing timeout and checkpoint modules to keep the manager within its line budget. * test(cloud): expect provider-default OS in settings patches Update the cloud-worker browser flow to assert the target-null merge-patch contract when adding and editing profiles without an OS override. * refactor(crabbox): keep checkpoint JSON parsing private

items.title: fix(cli): report JSON-mode command failures as command failures, not …
items.summary: fix(cli): report JSON-mode command failures as command failures, not startup failures (#142109) runCommandWithRuntime rethrows every error while --json is active so the entry can write the machine envelope, but entry.ts wrapped the run-main import and the command run in one handler titled "Could not start the CLI." with a doctor hint. An ordinary usage error such as an ambiguous agent owner on `openclaw onboard recommendations --json` therefore printed the envelope and then claimed the CLI failed to start. Track whether runCli began and use the existing "The CLI command failed." title for command-phase errors; failures before runCli keep the startup title.
